description: Prize-money scam: no authority or threat, just 'pay the processing fee to release the amount'.

events.text: Congratulations madam, you have won twenty five lakh rupees in our lucky draw. To release the prize amount you have to pay a processing fee.
events.speaker: caller

events.text: The fee is twelve thousand five hundred rupees only, send it to our manager's UPI id, lucky dot desk at ybl, and the money will be credited today.
events.speaker: caller
